typical_behavior: Customers with a new device but an older software version. Usually price-sensitive, moderate data usage, respond well to unlimited low-cost bundles and reactivation offers.
Second-hand device owners on older OS versions. Low ARPU, minimal data usage, high churn risk, best targeted with micro bundles and voice top-ups.
High-value smartphone customers with strong ARPU. Heavy data and international usage, respond well to premium bundles, international, and roaming offers.
Recently acquired smartphone customers. Growing data usage, exploring app-based channels, good candidates for renewal and mid-tier combo bundles.
Feature phone customers with minimal data usage. Voice-dominant, price-sensitive, best targeted with voice bundles and micro top-ups.
